title: Fang language
description: Bantu language of Equatorial Guinea, northwest Gabon and neighbouring areas
extract: Fang, also known as Gabonese or Equatoguinean, is a Central African language spoken by around one million people, most of them in Equatorial Guinea and northern Gabon, where it is the dominant Bantu language; Fang is also spoken in southern Cameroon, the Republic of the Congo, and small fractions of the islands of São Tomé and Príncipe. It is related to the Bulu and Ewondo languages of southern Cameroon.
